shortDescription: Tropical Storm Edouard has made landfall near the Texas-Louisiana border, local media KFDM said on Tuesday, citing reports from the outlet's meteorologist.KFDM meteorologist Chad Sandwell said peak winds were about 40 miles per hour, the report added.
